exercises.instr: There is one word missing in each line of the text. Where does the missing word go? What could it be? What part of speech is it?
exercises.instrFa: در هر سطر متن یک کلمه جا افتاده است. کلمهٔ جاافتاده کجا قرار می‌گیرد؟ چه می‌تواند باشد؟ چه نقشی دارد؟

items.en: Last year I went to ______ for my holiday. I spent the first week Seville staying with a couple of friends, and then I a train to Barcelona, where I spent another ten days. It is beautiful city and I had a marvellous time. I stayed in a very hotel right in the centre, but I didn't mind spending a lot money because it is a wonderful and very convenient. My brother recommended it; he goes Spain a lot and he stays anywhere else.
items.fa: سال گذشته برای تعطیلات به ______ رفتم...

exercises.instr: In the dialogue below, find at least one example of the following: an uncountable noun, a plural noun, a phrasal verb, and an idiom.
exercises.instrFa: در دیالوگ زیر حداقل یک مثال از این موارد پیدا کنید: اسم غیرقابل شمارش، اسم جمع، فعل عبارتی و اصطلاح.

items.en: A: It's 8 o'clock. We'd better get a move on if we're going to meet Sue at the airport. B: That's OK. Her flight doesn't get in until 8.50. A: Yes, but it'll take us an hour to get to the airport – you know what the traffic is like. B: OK. I'll just go and get changed. A: What's wrong with your shorts? B: I don't like driving in shorts. I'm going to put some jeans on.
items.fa: دیالوگ دربارهٔ رسیدن به فرودگاه برای ملاقات سو است.

exercises.instr: Look at the underlined verbs in these sentences. Which are transitive? Which are intransitive?
exercises.instrFa: به افعل زیرخط‌دار در این جملات نگاه کنید. کدام‌ها متعدی و کدام‌ها لازم هستند؟

items.en: He told me to sit down.

exercises.instr: How many syllables are there in each of these words? Now mark the main stress on each of the words.
exercises.instrFa: در هر یک از این کلمات چند هجا وجود دارد؟ حالا تکیهٔ اصلی هر کلمه را علامت بزنید.

exercises.instr: Look at these words and answer the questions below.
exercises.instrFa: به این کلمات نگاه کنید و به سؤال‌های زیر پاسخ دهید.

items.en: What part of speech are these words?
Change each one into an adverb.
items.fa: هر کدام را به قید تبدیل کنید.

items.en: Write down a synonym for the first two words.
items.fa: برای دو کلمهٔ اول یک مترادف بنویسید.

items.en: Which prefix do you need to form the opposite of the first two words?
items.fa: برای ساخت متضاد دو کلمهٔ اول به کدام پیشوند نیاز دارید؟

items.en: Write down the opposite of the last two words.
items.fa: متضاد دو کلمهٔ آخر را بنویسید.
